description: This walk takes you from the Dartmoor village of North Bovey to the neighbouring village of Lustleigh via the popular Lustleigh Cleave. The route runs for a distance of just under 5 miles, passing along the waymarked Dartmoor Way. You'll follow a mixture of quiet country lanes and peaceful woodland paths before arriving at picturesque Lustleigh. See the North Bovey Walks page for more walks from the village.
